reports.text:
This week felt too hard for me. I only got 5 right out of 31 cards, and matching was the worst: none right out of 8. Multiple choice was rough too, just 1 of 10, and typed meaning was 3 of 10. Read aloud went a bit better, 1 of 3, but 2 of my spoken answers weren't heard at all, which was frustrating when I did speak.

The good part is that words did come back. say, need, hey, something, more, way, too, only, make and never all returned the next day, so the app gave me a second try. But none repeated within a single session, so I never got to fix a mistake right away.

What bugs me is that down, people and because slipped away and no card ever asked me about them. I saved 14 new words, and I'd like those forgotten ones to come back.

This week felt too hard for me. I played on five days and got through 50 cards, but only 20 were right. The typed meaning and matching cards were the worst: 7 of 20 each. Read aloud went fine, 3 of 4, and multiple choice was okay at 3 of 5. The one say translation card I missed. Two of my spoken answers weren't heard at all, which was annoying.

Nothing repeated inside a session, so I never felt stuck on one word. Many words did come back, but mostly after 5 or 7 days, which was long enough that I'd lost them, like something, too, way and need. Only mean came back after 1 day.

What bothers me most is the words I forgot that no card asked about: down, people, because, please, love, said, sorry, give, even, much, thing, help. I'd like those to return sooner. I saved 15 new words, but it feels like I'm falling behind.

This week felt a bit too hard for me, and also uneven. I played on five days and got 25 right out of 50 cards, so about half. Typed meaning was the worst: only 8 right out of 20. Matching was better at 11 out of 20, and multiple choice felt fine at 4 out of 5. Say translation was rough, 2 out of 5, and 3 of my spoken answers weren't heard, which was annoying. Two cards couldn't be matched to a saved word either.

I never got the same word twice in one session, so nothing felt repetitive. Plenty of words did come back on later days, like make after 7 days and first after 6, which was nice.

What bothers me is the words I forgot that no card asked: down, people, because, please, love, said, sorry, give, even, much, thing, help. They never came back, and I'd have liked the chance to fix them.

This week felt mixed, leaning hard. I played four days and got through 40 cards, but only 15 were right. The typed meaning cards were the worst for me: 6 of 16. Matching was even rougher at 3 of 16. When I had to produce the word myself, I often blanked. Read aloud, multiple choice and the speaking cards I could do were easier, 3 of 3 each, though dictation and say translation went 0 for 1 each.

No word repeated within a session, so nothing felt like the same card again and again. Good, I guess. Plenty of old words did come back after 5 to 8 days, like too, say, way, still and more, and I half remembered them.

What bugs me is the words I forgot that never got asked: down, people, because, please, love, said, sorry, give, even, much, thing, help. I wanted another try at those. Two cards also didn't match any saved word, which was odd. I saved 10 new words.

This week felt a bit too hard for me. I played on 3 days and got 14 right out of 30 cards, so I was wrong more often than I'd like. Matching and typed meaning were the worst: 6 of 12 and 4 of 10. Multiple choice went badly too, with just 1 of 3. Reading aloud was fine, and the listen choice I got right, but dictation and say translation both went wrong.

Nothing repeated inside a session, so I never felt stuck on one word. Old words did come back, like make after 15 days and still after 12, and some of those were tough to remember.

What bothers me is the words that never came back. Down, only, people, because, please, love, sorry and a few others I've forgotten, and no card asked about them. I'd like them to show up soon. I saved 8 new words.

This week felt a bit too hard for me. I played on 4 days and got 18 right out of 40 cards, so I was wrong more often than I liked. Typing the meaning went best, 9 of 16. Matching was shakier, 6 of 16. Multiple choice was rough, 1 of 4, and saying the translation was 2 of 4. Two of my spoken answers weren't heard at all, which was annoying because I might have been right.

I never got the same word again and again in one session, so nothing felt repetitive. Old words did return, like mean, only, more, say and thought, but often after a long gap, and I had to dig for them.

What bothers me is the words I'd forgotten that no card asked about: down, people, because, please, love, said, sorry, give, even, much, thing, help. They never came back, and I'd have liked the chance to fix them.
